# fixtures

## Purpose
Reusable test fixtures and mock factories for unit and component tests.

## Key Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `content.ts` | Mock `CollectionEntry` factories for blog and project content collections |

## For AI Agents

### Working In This Directory
- Import via `@test/fixtures/content` path alias
- `createBlogEntry()` and `createProjectEntry()` factory functions return typed mock objects
- Factories accept partial overrides for test-specific customization
